scope: Separate selected development studies; do not pool the rows or infer general accuracy. Private source and raw findings are not included.

definitions.opportunity: One predefined concern tested in one repetition.
definitions.recovery: Verification of a frozen candidate, not fresh discovery.
definitions.step: One model turn, which can contain several tool calls.

studies.design: Four cases, three arms, three repetitions; isolated tools-enabled reviews via the earlier OpenCode route.
studies.decision: No demonstrated ordering advantage; zero primary credit is not zero detection.
studies.primary_credit_definition: A retained predefined target rated P0, P1 or P2; P3 detections do not earn primary credit.

studies.design: Direct DeepSeek, native tools, low effort; two collectors × two repetitions × three historical cases plus one synthetic clean case.
Direct DeepSeek, low main/aux effort, full review; prompt byte budgets and deadlines retained.
One selected positive candidate, two repetitions per arm; separate false controls.
studies.decision: Specific cap bottleneck; not general evidence for unlimited investigation.

studies.design: Two-case frozen-candidate check; explicit prompt notice, six steps retained.
studies.result: No correct behavioral confirmation gain; one source-supported confirmation lost.
Prompt size roughly fivefold; no overall quality gain. Cap/output conflict exposed.
studies.decision: Fix runtime; no bulk read dump shipped.

studies.design: Two-case direct-API frozen-candidate replay, one baseline/patched pair per case.
studies.result: All completed in six steps with valid JSON. One supported concern recovered; another raw confirmation lacked producer proof and was not credited.
studies.decision: Ship delivery and accounting fixes, no broad recall claim.

studies.design: Two-case direct-API verifier replay; one pair per case.
studies.result: False controls rejected; lost confirmation was model uncertainty, not a raw confirmation rejected by the source gate.

studies.design: Two-case frozen-candidate replay; proof policy held fixed.
studies.result: Delivery improved, verification recovery did not.

studies.design: Two cases × three arms; one draw per arm/case, direct DeepSeek low effort, proof gate off.
studies.decision: Keep default context and six steps.

studies.design: Two-case frozen verifier replay, one pair per case.
studies.result: Extra confirmation used manually staged test state instead of an application transition. Needed excerpts were displaced.

studies.design: Low main/aux effort used as a control in direct studies.
studies.result: No conclusive isolated medium/high or complexity-adaptive comparison established in this note.
